event_summary: A brown oblong object moves from the top of a tall transparent glass into blue liquid, causing visible waves before coming to rest near the bottom.
raw_event_description: At the start, a tall transparent glass stands on a wooden surface with blue liquid in its lower portion and a green band around the outside near the liquid surface. A brown oblong object is held at the top opening by blue prong-like pieces. The brown object then moves downward into the glass and into the blue liquid. The liquid surface becomes disturbed with waves and splashes inside the glass. The brown object continues downward while partly obscured by the liquid and later remains visible near the lower part of the glass, tilted near the bottom, as the liquid surface settles.

reasons: The glass and liquid are clearly visible.
The top holding pieces and upper part of the brown object are partly cropped by the frame edge.
